name: fourt2py
description: Browser demo for FOURT.F (shape a waveform in the frequency domain) compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: emcc -O2 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s SINGLE_FILE=0 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_fourt_,_malloc,_free -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=cwrap,ccall,getValue,setValue -o wasm/fourt.mjs wasm/fourt.c
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run web/
